argv:
set -e
A=products/actors/rss-reader
mkdir -p $A/src $A/actor-config
: > $A/src/__init__.py
cat > $A/src/__main__.py <<'EOF'
import asyncio
from .main import main
asyncio.run(main())
EOF
cat > $A/src/main.py <<'EOF'
import asyncio
from apify import Actor
from .core import read_feed

MAX_FEEDS = 100


async def main():
    async with Actor:
        inp = await Actor.get_input() or {}
        urls = [u.strip() for u in (inp.get("feedUrls") or []) if isinstance(u, str) and u.strip()]
        try:
            max_items = int(inp.get("maxItems") or 50)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            max_items = 50
        max_items = max(1, min(max_items, 1000))
        if not urls:
            await Actor.fail(status_message="Provide at least one public feed URL in feedUrls")
            return
        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urls))[:MAX_FEEDS]
        for url in urls:
            rows = await asyncio.to_thread(read_feed, url, max_items)
            for row in rows:
                await Actor.push_data(row)
                if row["row_type"] == "item":
                    await Actor.charge(event_name="item-parsed")
EOF
echo 'apify>=2.0.0' > $A/requirements.txt
cp products/actors/csv-preflight/Dockerfile $A/Dockerfile
cat > $A/actor-config/actor.json <<'EOF'
{
 "actorSpecification": 1,
 "name": "rss-reader",
 "title": "RSS & Atom Feed Reader to JSON",
 "version": "0.1",
 "input": "./input_schema.json",
 "dockerfile": "../Dockerfile",
 "minMemoryMbytes": 128,
 "maxMemoryMbytes": 512,
 "defaultMemoryMbytes": 256
}
EOF
cat > $A/actor-config/input_schema.json <<'EOF'
{
 "title": "RSS reader input",
 "type": "object",
 "schemaVersion": 1,
 "properties": {
  "feedUrls": {
   "title": "Feed URLs",
   "type": "array",
   "editor": "stringList",
   "description": "Public RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 or Atom feed URLs (http/https only, at most 100 per run, at most 5 MiB each).",
   "prefill": ["https://github.blog/feed/"]
  },
  "maxItems": {
   "title": "Max items per feed",
   "type": "integer",
   "editor": "number",
   "default": 50,
   "minimum": 1,
   "maximum": 1000,
   "description": "Items kept per feed, in document order."
  }
 },
 "required": ["feedUrls"]
}
EOF
python3 -m py_compile $A/src/main.py $A/src/__main__.py && python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('$A/actor-config/actor.json'));json.load(open('$A/actor-config/input_schema.json'));print('PKG_OK')"
